_comment: EMULATOR ONLY. The robot starts the emulator with --config firebase.emulator.json
so the sandbox loads firestore.emulator.rules instead of the production rules.
Why this file exists: firestore.rules names Rafael's real account id, so inside
the emulator - where the sandbox account has a different id - every write is
refused and the apps appear broken for a reason that has nothing to do with
them. Pointing firebase.json at the emulator rules instead would be worse:
anyone deploying the repo would publish a wildcard and reopen every collection.
So production config stays in firebase.json and the robot overrides it here.
